rows.label: tlk70000032_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Ah, Adel-sama! Nothing unusual to
report today.

rows.label: tlk70000032_01_msg0002
rows.name:
...So Nittle-san gave me a thorough
lesson on Iira's history.

rows.label: tlk70000032_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Did you know this palace was built
with the help of many Blades and
Drivers?

rows.label: tlk70000032_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Back then, many countries, starting
with Superbia, saw technological
revolutions and political unrest...

rows.label: tlk70000032_01_msg0005
rows.name:
That's why this palace was built. As
a statement to people both at home
and abroad of what Iira stands for.

rows.label: tlk70000032_01_msg0006
rows.name:
It's a testament to the belief that by
working together, we can make up for
our flaws and enhance our strengths.

rows.label: tlk70000032_01_msg0007
rows.name:
I thought this palace was impressive,
but never knew it carried that
meaning. I must guard it well!
